payload.title: Spike: claim and brand-safety check on generated creative
payload.description: Highest-fit candidate. A batch sweep (Papyrus relevance-sweep pattern: claim, restore store, apply human labels, decide pending, record status, snapshot) over generated narration and copy, flagging unsupported or price claims and tone issues for human review, never auto-approving. Hard must-block rules stay deterministic. Needs the creative approval flow from babulus-09376e.
